### 🇨🇳 中文更新日志
* 🚀 **新增免连接拟真演示模式 (Demo Mode)**：
  * 支持新用户与 App Store 审核免配置一键进入演示环境，体验 Unraid 遥测仪表盘（CPU、内存、阵列磁盘、风扇与 UPS 电源监控）；
  * 深度内置拟真虚拟终端 Shell（支持高频 Linux/Docker 命令行交互）与模拟文件系统浏览器；
  * 提供醒目的演示模式胶囊状态提示与一键安全退出重连通道。
* 🎨 **欢迎配置页（Onboarding）极简紧凑首屏重构**：
  * 落地极简紧凑首屏排版，实现 0 滚动全览视图与多端屏幕自适应；
  * Logo 与标题升级为水平并排居中排版，显著提升屏幕空间利用率与品牌质感；
  * 输入框占位符明度与文本层级全面优化：提示语柔和降噪，真实输入文本高对比醒目。
* 🌐 **智能相册模块全量英文国际化适配**：
  * 针对相册初始化向导、GPU 硬件加速直通配置、转码画质、视频动态预览及文件夹选择器全面实现中英双语国际化；
  * 首次配置欢迎页与主导航支持语言一键即时切换。

### 🇬🇧 English Changelog
* 🚀 **New Interactive Demo Mode (Zero-Config Experience)**:
  * Allows new users and App Store review to explore all core Unraid management features without server credentials.
  * Realistically simulates live telemetry dashboard (CPU, RAM, array disks, sensors, and UPS power).
  * Built-in interactive virtual terminal shell (supporting common Linux/Docker commands) and mock file system explorer.
  * Clear demo banner indicator with one-click instant safe exit to welcome setup.
* 🎨 **Redesigned Compact & Clean Onboarding Welcome Screen**:
  * Adopted an ultra-compact single-screen flow for complete zero-scroll overview across mobile and desktop.
  * Aligned Logo and app title into a sleek horizontal inline header.
  * Enhanced input field typography and contrast hierarchy: dimmed placeholder hints and sharp, high-contrast input text.
* 🌐 **Full English Localization for Smart Photos & Setup**:
  * Completely internationalized gallery initialization, GPU hardware acceleration options, transcode quality, motion video preview settings, and folder picker dialogs.
  * Added instant language quick-toggle button to the welcome configuration header.
